categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in research, development, production, and sales of optical communication transceiver modules (光通信收发模块). The company has developed over 1,000 different models of optical modules covering transmission speeds from 1G to 800G, serving applications in data centers, long-distance transmission, wireless networks, and fixed-line access. The company also provides ODM/JDM services and optical engine solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in optical chip integration (COC), optical devices (TOSA/ROSA), and optical module design and manufacturing. Key technologies include: advanced optical coupling processes, high-speed signal link modeling and simulation, mixed-signal circuit design, low-power design techniques, electromagnetic shielding technology, and packaging technologies for various optical devices (BOX, COB, TO-CAN). The company has mastered production processes from 10G to 800G optical modules and is developing next-generation technologies including silicon photonics (SIP), thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), and co-packaged optics (CPO).
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves international telecommunications equipment manufacturers and data communication equipment providers, including major customers such as NOKIA, Arista, ADTRAN, Halo, Ciena, and Infinera. Domestically, the company serves customers including ZTE Communications, H3C, Ruijie Networks, and Inspur. The primary markets are data centers (the fastest-growing segment), telecommunications networks, and emerging markets including consumer electronics and industrial automation. The company's products are widely used in AI computing clusters, 5G networks, and cloud infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing and R&D centers in Wuhan (China), Malaysia, and the United States. The company has established sales and service operations in multiple regions. In 2024, overseas sales accounted for 89.07% of total revenue, with major markets in North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The company has subsidiaries including Linktel Technologies, Inc. (USA), LINKTEL TECHNOLOGIES PTE.LIMITED (Singapore), and LINKTEL TECHNOLOGIES SDN.BHD. (Malaysia).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the optical communications supply chain. The company designs and manufactures optical modules and optical devices, which are key components in optical communication systems. The company sources optical chips and integrated circuits from upstream suppliers and sells finished optical modules to telecommunications equipment manufacturers and data center operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) advancing high-speed optical module technology, particularly 800G and 1.6T products; (2) developing next-generation technologies including silicon photonics, thin-film lithium niobate modulators, and co-packaged optics; (3) expanding global manufacturing capacity, particularly through the Malaysia facility; (4) enhancing product competitiveness in cost, power consumption, and performance; (5) strengthening R&D capabilities in optical-electrical integration and chip-level integration; (6) pursuing market leadership in wave division multiplexing and high-speed optical modules.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of optical modules to telecommunications equipment manufacturers and data center operators. The revenue model is based on product sales with different pricing tiers depending on transmission speed, distance, and wavelength specifications. The company also generates revenue from ODM/JDM services and optical engine solutions. In 2024, direct sales accounted for 95.31% of total revenue, with the remaining from agency sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both international and domestic optical module manufacturers. International competitors include established players like Ciena, Infinera, and others. Domestic competitors include ZTE Communications, H3C, and other Chinese optical equipment manufacturers. The company positions itself as a rapidly growing supplier with advantages in product diversity, quality stability, fast delivery, and professional after-sales service. The company is particularly strong in wave division multiplexing products and mid-to-high-speed optical modules, and is one of the fastest-growing suppliers in these segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of 891.05 million yuan, representing 47.11% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 92.95 million yuan, up 250.99% from the prior year. The company's total assets reached 2.22 billion yuan at year-end 2024, with net assets of 1.51 billion yuan. The company has demonstrated strong growth trajectory, with revenue growing from 605.72 million yuan in 2023 and 824.71 million yuan in 2022. The company's profitability has improved significantly, with gross margin increasing to 30.35% in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) comprehensive product portfolio covering 1G to 800G transmission speeds with over 1,000 different models; (2) superior product quality and reliability with multiple international certifications; (3) fast delivery and responsive customer service; (4) advanced technology capabilities in optical-electrical integration and high-speed signal processing; (5) cost-effective solutions through continuous process optimization; (6) low-power consumption designs suitable for AI and data center applications; (7) global manufacturing presence enabling localized support; (8) strong R&D capabilities for next-generation technologies including silicon photonics and co-packaged optics.
